# Helper Functions 

```{r}

mat_df2 <- function(matrix, labels=NULL) {
  df <- as.data.frame(matrix) |>
    mutate(row_num = row_number()) |>
    pivot_longer(!row_num, names_to = "col_num") |>
    mutate(col_num = as.numeric(str_replace(col_num, "V", "")))

  row_dist <- dist(matrix)
  col_dist <- dist(t(matrix))
  
  h_row <- hclust(row_dist)
  h_col <- hclust(col_dist)
  df <- df |>
    inner_join(tibble(
      row_num = h_row$order,
      order_row = 1:length(h_row$order)
    )) |>
    inner_join(tibble(
      col_num = h_col$order,
      order_col = 1:length(h_col$order)
    ))

  if (is.null(labels)) {
    return(df)
  } else {
    df <- df |>
      inner_join(tibble(row_num = 1:length(h_row$order), label = labels))
  }
  df
}
```

# Convex Clustering Examples

```{r}


per_cluster <- 30
num_solutions <- 9

set.seed(2)
X <- rbind(
  mvrnorm(per_cluster, c(1,1), matrix(c(1, 0.5, 0.5, 1), nrow=2)),
  mvrnorm(per_cluster, c(-2.25,1), matrix(c(0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 0.75), nrow=2)),
  mvrnorm(per_cluster, c(0,-1.75), matrix(c(1.5, 0, 0, 0.25), nrow=2))
)

X <- t(X)

w <- kernel_weights(X, 0.5)
w <- knn_weights(w, 3, ncol(X))

gammas <- c(0.1, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 35, 50, 100)

solutions <- cvxclust_path_admm(X, w, gammas)

to_plot <- tibble(
  orig_x = numeric(),
  orig_y = numeric(),
  new_x = numeric(),
  new_y = numeric(),
  gamma = numeric(),
  index = numeric(),
  true_cluster = numeric(),
)

for(i in 1:num_solutions) {
  to_plot <- rbind(
    to_plot,
    tibble(
      orig_x = X[1,],
      orig_y = X[2,],
      new_x = solutions$U[[i]][1,],
      new_y = solutions$U[[i]][2,],
      gamma = rep(gammas[i], ncol(X)),
      index = 1:ncol(X),
      true_cluster = rep(c(1, 2, 3), times = 1, each = per_cluster),
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}

custom_labeller <- function(variable, value) {
  return(paste0("gamma=", value))
}

ggplot(to_plot) +
  geom_point(aes(orig_x, orig_y), alpha=0.25) +
  geom_segment(aes(group=index, x=orig_x, y=orig_y, xend=new_x, yend=new_y), 
               alpha=0.25, linetype=2) +
  geom_point(aes(new_x, new_y), color="blue") +
  facet_wrap(~gamma, labeller=custom_labeller) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank()
  )

```

```{r}
gammas <- seq(0, 100, 0.25)

num_solutions <- length(gammas)
solutions <- cvxclust_path_admm(X, w, gammas)

to_plot <- tibble(
  orig_x = numeric(),
  orig_y = numeric(),
  new_x = numeric(),
  new_y = numeric(),
  gamma = numeric(),
  index = numeric(),
  true_cluster = numeric(),
)

for(i in 1:num_solutions) {
  to_plot <- rbind(
    to_plot,
    tibble(
      orig_x = X[1,],
      orig_y = X[2,],
      new_x = solutions$U[[i]][1,],
      new_y = solutions$U[[i]][2,],
      gamma = rep(gammas[i], ncol(X)),
      index = 1:ncol(X),
      true_cluster = rep(c(1, 2, 3), times = 1, each = per_cluster),
    )
  )
}

```

```{r}
ggplot(to_plot) +
  geom_point(aes(orig_x, orig_y), alpha=0.15) +
  geom_path(aes(group=index, x=new_x, y=new_y, color=as.character(true_cluster)), 
               alpha=0.25, linetype=2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  ggtitle("Convex clustering solution path for 3 clusters")

```

# Biclustering Example

```{r}
checker <- gen_checkerboard(300, 300, 10, 10, noise=1.5, shuffle = TRUE, prob_empty = 0.5, scale=FALSE)

ggplot(mat_df2(checker$X), aes(x = order_col, y = order_row)) +
    geom_raster(aes(fill = value)) +
    scale_fill_gradient2() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

from_palm3 <- tune_bcbc(checker$X, model=palm, lambdas=c(0), gammas=2^seq(10, 15, 0.5), recalculate_weights = TRUE, progress = TRUE)
```

# Clustering Dimension

```{r}
set.seed(20)
check <- gen_checkerboard(100, 200, 10, 10, noise=1, p_extra=1000)

all_checks <- list()
all_checks[[1]] <- cbind(check$X,
                         (matrix(rnorm(100*100, sd=1), nrow=100)))
for(i in 2:10) {
  all_checks[[i]] <- cbind(all_checks[[i-1]],
                           (matrix(rnorm(100*100, sd=1), nrow=100)))
}




```



# Real Data

```{r}
plot_fit <- function(matrix, labels, title="") {
  plot_df <- mat_df2(matrix, labels)
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = order_col, y = order_row)) +
    geom_raster(aes(fill = value)) +
    annotate(
      geom = "rect",
      xmin = -ncol(matrix) / 25,
      xmax = 0,
      ymin = plot_df$order_row - 0.5,
      ymax = plot_df$order_row + 0.5,
      fill = case_when(
        plot_df$label == 1 ~ "green",
        plot_df$label == 2 ~ "yellow",
        plot_df$label == 3 ~ "purple",
        plot_df$label == 4 ~ "grey",
        plot_df$label == 5 ~ "orange",
        plot_df$label == 6 ~ "blue",
        plot_df$label == 7 ~ "red",
        plot_df$label == 8 ~ "magenta",
        plot_df$label == 9 ~ "pink",
        TRUE ~ "black"
      )
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    ) +
    # guides(fill = "none") +
    xlab("") +
    ylab("") +
    ggtitle(title)
}

```

## Leuk

```{r}
# sparsebc_leuk <- readRDS("./sparsebc_leuk.RDS")
# palm_leuk <- readRDS("./palm_leuk2.RDS")
# cobra_leuk <- readRDS("./cobra_leuk.RDS")

leuk_y <- read.csv("./data/leukemia.y.txt", header = FALSE)
leuk <- t(read.csv("./data/leukemia.x.txt", header = FALSE, sep = " "))
leuk <- scale(leuk)
```

```{r}
plot_fit(leuk, leuk_y$V1, "Gene Expression Pattern of Leukemia Samples")
```

```{r}

igraph::compare(palm_leuk$row_clusters[[100]],
                leuk_y$V1,
                method="adjusted.rand")

plot_fit(palm_leuk$all_runs[[100]]$U,
         leuk_y$V1,
         "Gene Expression Pattern of Leukemia Samples (PALM)")
```

```{r}

igraph::compare(sparsebc_leuk$Cs,
                leuk_y$V1,
                method="adjusted.rand")

plot_fit(sparsebc_leuk$mus,
         leuk_y$V1,
         "Gene Expression Pattern of Leukemia Samples (SparseBC)")
```

```{r}
igraph::compare(cobra_leuk$groups_col[[24]]$cluster,
                leuk_y$V1,
                method="adjusted.rand")

plot_fit(t(cobra_leuk$U[[24]]),
         leuk_y$V1,
         "Gene Expression Pattern of Leukemia Samples (COBRA)")
```
